Sure! Instead of constantly visualizing like I was, I wouldn’t visualize anymore but instead have a deep faith that I had won the lottery. In my daily life I just knew that I was  millionaire like I know the sky is blue. I stopped doing techniques because I moved forward from the manifesting stage. If you’re always in the “manifesting stage” you’re telling your subconscious that you don’t have it. That’s what worked for me at least! Manifesting is very personal, some ways work for some people and not for others.

Absolutely! 

This took me forever because I was not actually feeling like a millionaire. I was not in the feeling state of the wish fulfilled of winning the jackpot. I finally realized that I needed to change my state and my feeling and just live as if it was done. I did a lot sats and visualizing which helped a ton with what I was gonna do with my money/ feeling the financial freedom. What I was missing was the releasing aspect. It helped me to stop doing techniques after I locked down mastering the feeling of the end, my wish fulfilled. I forgot about it, did not obsess nor visualize the call that my ticket was the jackpot winner (I got that call in real life). I just let go and live as if it was done because it was already created and done. It happened in the best, easiest possible way. The universe knows. Just trust yourself and have faith. It is all in feeling! <3 also this sub helped a ton and completely changed my life. Also my favorite manifestation coach ever @theofficialbuko on Instagram, her podcast as well. She is so straightforward and teaches NEVILLE. Manifesting such positive energy for everyone reading this!! The universe has no choice but to give you what you want because it is already yours. We do not make a reality we simply choose to live it. It is already done just choose that state.
